channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's real wins were concrete and mid-sized: Warmkraft's $16M defense-textile facility in Mayagüez (65 jobs, DDEC Act 60 incentives), Ferrovial's $239M autonomous-machinery runway project at Aguadilla's airport, four new solar-plus-battery farms doubling Puerto Rico's utility-scale clean energy capacity, and smaller but tangible moves from MassMutual, RioBlanco Capital, Enterprise, FirstBank, and SolX Aguadilla's restart. Real risks continue to build: the Planning Board cut GNP growth forecasts again, a federal Medicaid funding cliff threatens up to a million residents, tariffs added $14M to a FEMA-funded energy project, and only 8% of the $14.7B disaster-reconstruction allocation has been disbursed. Much of the remaining volume this week was routine cost-of-living, drought, and Fed-rate coverage with limited direct investment signal.
